metadata.title: Space Apps Challenge 2026 - FieldShift: Kansas Cover Crop vs. Fallow Trial Benchmarks
metadata.description: Site-year cover crop versus fallow benchmark records for semi-arid western Kansas and humid eastern Kansas, for the in-app Methodology modal and project submission.
metadata.comparison: Cover crop fallow replacement relative to chemical or bare fallow reference
notes: Records marked benchmark_scenario are harmonized illustrative site-year benchmarks for hackathon use, not a transcription of a single published trial table.
Western severe-drought scenarios are calibrated to the requested 46-48% yield penalty and -172 to -176 USD/ha incremental net-return benchmark.
Eastern humid gains are represented as negative yield_penalty_pct. Site-specific effect sizes vary by crop, cover species, year, and management.
Precipitation is seasonal scenario precipitation; net_return_usd_ha is cover-crop-minus-fallow difference, not absolute farm profit.
